entry.title: don’t wait for the tide just to dip both your feet in
entry.summary:
Author: fleetinghearts

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 3,588Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 19

Summary: Buck considers his options. There are two things that could be going on.One: Eddie is just embarrassed by his slip-up at the beach. Kissing your friend on the back of his neck isn’t something they usually do—with each other or any of their friends—so this is just Eddie being self-conscious. Buck could ignore it and it wouldn’t affect their lives in any way.Option two is different. Buck’s less sure of this one. It’s just—if it were him doling out kisses of affection with the people he loves and trusts and is building his life around? He’d be pretty embarrassed to give a kiss and not receive one back. Or, maybe not embarrassed. Maybe a flavour of rejection. And now he knows he’s definitely projecting, because Eddie doesn’t grapple with rejection the same way Buck does. or, sometimes, your best friend is so full of love he accidentally kisses you on a public beach. buck takes a second to notice

entry.title: To Let Go
entry.summary:
Author: Semibold

Rating: Not RatedLanguage: EnglishWords: 11,831Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 16

Summary: Reluctantly, Buck rolled over to his phone and pushed stop. He swung his legs over the bed and rubbed his eyes. He tried to remind himself that he loved his job, and that he’d get to see Chim and Hen and Eddie and Ravi and… not Bobby Great it wasn’t even 7 a.m. and he was already thinking about Bobby. This was gonna be a long day. With a lot of luck (and a little bit of speeding) he made it to the fire house with 5 minutes to spare. He raced to the locker room and switched into his uniform. There hadn’t been time to make coffee at home, so Buck jogged up the stairs, and made his way to the kitchen. Not even two steps off the landing, he stopped dead in his tracks; because there, at the stovetop, was an all too familiar face. He must be hallucinating; because there was no possible way. But there he was Bobby. ---- Buck has not been dealing with Bobby's death leading him to be carless in the field. It catches up to him though, and now Buck must find his way out of another coma and back home to the people he loves.
